messages:
Marisol: FYI HorizonPay renewal in ~45 days — seat activity down ~72% last 30d, new ML lead is trialing CompetitorX, procurement has paused approvals. Need quick read + rescue plan. :warning:

Devon: Oof. Any concrete asks from procurement or the new ML lead? Did AE get a why from them?

Marisol: AE had a call last Thursday. Procurement flagged cost + intermittent latency spikes. ML lead demoed comp's model for a specific rerank flow. I pulled quick metrics:
```
active_users: 8 -> 2
monthly_api_tokens: 1.2M -> 340k
avg_latency_p99: 420ms -> 620ms (during bursts)
errors_5xx: +12% last 2w
```
They mentioned burst timeouts when they hit peak inference.

Ravi: Can you share a sample trace or failing request payload? If it's timeout-related we might be able to tune batching/kv cache to improve p99. Also we can propose quantized variant to cut token cost.

Marisol: Dropping a minimal trace snippet below. Not full logs (sensitive):
```
[2026-05-12 14:03:22] ERROR 502 /v1/generate ctx=timeout seq=120 client=HorizonPay
payload: {"prompt_len": 512, "seq_len": 1024, "batch": 6}
```
They see 502s under burst concurrency ~6.

Lina: I'll run a cost vs. competitor delta and a one-pager; can include Dedicated burst pricing and a short performance POC outline. ETA 24h.

Devon: Proposed playbook before renewal: 1) immediate 30-min EBR with procurement + ML lead (tomorrow) 2) perf snapshot + timeout RCA 3) cost savings one-pager + short Dedicated POC offer 4) ask for 30-day short-term commit to prevent churn. Who can own each?

Marisol: I'll set up the EBR and loop AE. @Ravi can you own perf snapshot + RCA? @Lina owns the one-pager. @Devon can own procurement ask and draft POC terms.

OnboardBot: Reminder — HorizonPay onboarding check: integration tests step 5 still failing (flaky), ticket CS-1927 open.

Ravi: Acknowledged. I'll start with reproducing the 502 locally with same batch/concurrency and check kernel dispatch and batching thresholds. If it's a batching flush issue we can patch config quickly.

Devon: If we can offer a short Dedicated burst slot (48-72h) to demonstrate p99 < 300ms that could neutralize latency concern. Cost offset idea: temporary discount for the POC window. Thoughts?

Lina: I'll model savings for two scenarios: a) optimized hosted config + quantization (expected ~25-35% cost reduction) b) Dedicated burst POC with temporary pricing. Will include expected p99 improvements based on our perf bench.

Marisol: Action items consolidated: 
- Ravi: perf snapshot + timeout root cause and short mitigation plan (24h)
- Lina: cost vs comp one-pager + POC pricing options (24h)
- Marisol: schedule EBR and intro to new ML lead & procurement (today)
- Devon: draft procurement ask & POC terms, lead EBR (tomorrow)
- AE: (Marisol will request) get procurement calendar availability and any specific success criteria for comp eval

Devon: I'll prep suggested contract language for a 30-day bridge commit and a follow-up SLA window.

Marisol: Sending intro now. Please flag if you need access to their logs or additional account perms. :thumbsup:

Ravi: One quick note — if the client's model sequence lengths are spiking to 2k, we should propose a shorter prefix + caching strategy; that can cut token cost and latency simultaneously. I'll include that in RCA.

Lina: Added to the one-pager scope. Also will attach a simple graph showing dropped seats vs. integration-test failures to help procurement see risk correlation.

Marisol: Thanks team. Marked HorizonPay renewal as high priority in CRM and added this thread link to the account. I'll update after EBR. :eyes:
